_comment: Grip poses of the staff style (G6c: Ambrose's cauldron staff; G5 builds the style's animations on them, G10 the riding ones). Conventions in tools/herogen/anim/poses.py.

staff.stance._comment: Caster ready: the right forearm raised forward so the staff stands upright beside the body, its head (the cauldron) above the shoulder, the left hand open and a little forward.

staff.cast._comment: The cast: the staff thrust forward and up at the target with the right arm straight, the left hand behind it.

ride.broom._comment: A seat on the staff-broom, for the mount point (G6c: the prop's `mount.seat` is under the hips at the height of the thighs' undersides; G10 authors `move.ride`, side-saddle, on it): astride, thighs level and a little apart, shins tucked back, leaning forward, the right hand on the shaft in front and the left out, ready to cast. Not a hand pose of the style (its name is outside `staff.`).
